# Cyber Kings - Sci-Fi Culture Appearances (generated by gen_all.py; do not hand-edit)
# Portrait fallbacks for characters without a stamped race (died before game start): race from culture,
# each look dimension at its most common value.
ck_portrait_race_antecessor_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_character_flag = ck_race_antecessor
		AND = { NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_race_set } ck_culture_is_antecessor_trigger = yes }
	}
}
